BiblicalUsage: Ephphatha is the Aramaic word Jesus spoke to the deaf man: Be opened. He looked up to heaven, sighed, and said it — and straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus opens what is shut — ears, tongues, and hearts — and He does it with a sigh and a command.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals a Deaf and Mute Man in the Decapolis
